map.闪光灯指数 GN 计算器由闪光指数与拍摄距离求可用光圈（ISO100），辅助室内: The flash index GN calculator finds the usable aperture (ISO 100) from flash index and shooting distance, aiding indoor or night fill-light exposure settings, suitable for location lighting.
map.由 GN 与距离求可用光圈（ISO100）。: Find the usable aperture (ISO 100) from GN and distance.
map.：GN=40、距离 10m（ISO100）：可用光圈 f = GN/d = 40: : GN = 40, distance 10 m (ISO 100): usable aperture f = GN / d = 40 / 10 = f/4; at 5 m it is f/8; closer needs a smaller aperture to avoid overexposure.
map.：ISO 从 100 升到 400：修正系数 = √(400/100) = 2，: : ISO from 100 to 400: correction factor = sqrt(400/100) = 2, equivalent GN = 80, same distance gives f/8.
map.闪光指数，GN = 光圈 f × 距离 m（ISO100）；越大闪光越强，是选灯: Flash index, GN = aperture f x distance m (ISO 100); larger means stronger flash, the core for lamp choice and exposure.
map.影响，GN 随 √(ISO/100) 增；高 ISO 等效 GN 增大，同距可用: Effect: GN increases with sqrt(ISO/100); higher ISO means higher equivalent GN, smaller aperture at same distance.
